method_limit: Illustrative control architecture only. Mappings describe intended governance coverage; they do not evidence completed conditions, active monitoring, executed covenants, observed breaches, or Coinbase policy.

mappings.control_objective: Maintain required recovery coverage using eligible and operationally available collateral.
Preserve ownership, priority, enforceability, and lender control.
Keep the collateral-to-bank repayment route tested and within the approved time.
Maintain borrowing-entity liquidity available for primary repayment.
Detect deterioration against the approved operating cash forecast and use of proceeds.
Prevent unapproved secured debt or liens from weakening repayment or priority.
Keep the facility within single-name and shared-risk concentration capacity.
Ensure complete and timely financial, collateral, and covenant reporting.
